notes: New SN1987A constraint from axion-photon conversion in progenitor star magnetic field (100 G surface field, conservative). Extends previous limits to higher masses (up to ~10^-3 eV) by accounting for conversion in stellar magnetic fields of blue supergiant progenitor, in addition to Galactic fields. Includes Primakoff, nucleon bremsstrahlung, and pion conversion production mechanisms. ALP model with loop-induced hadronic couplings. Paper also presents future projections for next Galactic SN with proposed GALAXIS instrument (not included in data_points as those are projections, not measured limits). Low-mass limit |g_agamma| ≲ 2.6×10^-12 GeV^-1 consistent with prior work; improvement at higher masses is novel. | selector: text (sole candidate)
